competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 35% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to stun the target for 1 turn with a 30% chance and decrease their Attack Bar by 30% with a 30% chance. Increases your Attack Bar by 30% if the target is stunned. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Decreases your HP by 10% and creates a shield equal to 20% of your MAX HP for 2 turns at the start of your turn. While having a shield, gains immunity against inability effects and counterattacks with [Triple Roundhouse Kick] when you are attacked on the enemy's turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Target's HP is reduced by an amount
effets.note: At the start of your turn

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
effets.note: At the start of your turn

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
effets.note: If you are attacked on the enemy's turn while having the shield
